name: Bake.gg
storyline: Cat never planned on running a bakery. It belonged to her grandmother, Rosie, who kept it going for the better part of forty years before she passed and left it to Cat in her will. The ovens still work and the regulars still turn up every morning expecting their pastries, so Cat ties on the apron, takes her place behind the register, and gets to baking. She brings in a few cats to help around the shop, puts the old delivery van back on the road, and sets about building the place back into what Rosie made it.
summary: Bake.gg is a free-to-play bakery idle game played entirely within Discord. Players prepare and serve pastries and drinks, place them on counters to earn coins and XP, and gradually expand and customize their own pixel-art bakery. Along the way they collect cats with unique abilities, run ice cream delivery vans, and compete with friends on global leaderboards.
